ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms the base image digest, runtime user and the build-secret flag are declared; it does not inspect a built image.
offer: Pin the container base and use an unprivileged runtime user. Build secrets must not enter the resulting image layers; config inspection alone cannot verify a built image.

minimal.reason: Pin the base image by digest. A tag can change underneath the build, so record the immutable digest.

mid.reason: Name an unprivileged runtime user. Running as root widens the blast radius, so declare a non-root user.

maximal.reason: Set including build secrets to false. Secrets copied into layers persist in the image, so use build-time mounts that leave no layer.
